query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM workflow_events
                WHERE (tx, position) > (
                        COALESCE((SELECT last_tx FROM workflow_event_consumers WHERE consumer_id = $1),
                                 '0'::xid8),
                        COALESCE((SELECT last_position FROM workflow_event_consumers WHERE consumer_id = $1),
                                 0))
            ) AS "pending!"
